strategy: Preserve American Road terrain and longitudinal slopes. Modify selected local road corridors. Prefer existing concrete and cobblestone assets. Import only permission-cleared local donor meshes if necessary, never concatenate terrain binaries.
candidate_metric_basis: All valid original nodes and consecutive XY chords; raw serialized node coordinates, not terrain raycasts or evaluated splines. Width is decal width, not guaranteed drivable clearance. Candidates are independent, connectivity unverified.

route_candidates.action: First inspect this narrow rolling corridor. Retain original height profile; trial concrete and cobble segments only in a private copy.
Concrete baseline test section; mild grades, not the hillclimb section.
Second concrete candidate; inspect connections before treating it as part of one route.
Optional hill corridor. Inspect steep outliers and scenery first; narrow only a verified roadbed segment, not the entire road.
Reference only. AI spline does not contain the collidable road mesh. Permission and mesh crop/collision validation required before importing.

gates: Confirm actual BeamNG.tech user folder and native editor version without reading license keys.
Obtain permission appropriate to private derivative use and any later redistribution; original author and upstream conversion rights are unresolved.
Independently load each original map in an isolated user profile after explicit approval; collect parse, material and collision diagnostics.
Create a private copy with a unique level namespace; audit paths, material names/mapTo, forest types, persistent IDs and source dependencies without modifying original ZIPs.
Inspect selected routes in the editor and measure actual terrain/mesh contact heights and usable widths.
Build and drive-test a short concrete/cobble test section before scaling up. Preserve baseline grades and avoid duplicate collision surfaces.
Resolve missing runtime dependencies with Resource Checker; do not rewrite all foreign paths blindly.

Only if wholesale terrain import is still required: use verified native heightmap export or a version-tested decoder; preserve height encoding, grid scale, holes and material layers, transform all scene and forest data, and validate seams.
